name: Trade class code
description: Code identifying the class of trade.

values.name: Financial service provider
values.description: Financial service provider A manager of money or other assets.

values.name: Importer
values.description: Importer A person or group that imports goods or services.

values.name: Vendor
values.description: Vendor A person or group selling goods or services.

values.name: Exporter
values.description: Exporter A person or group who sends goods or services to a foreign country.

values.name: Agency
values.description: Agency A party or group that acts as an agent on behalf of another party.

values.name: Buying group
values.description: Buying group A temporary group of buyers formed for purchasing purposes.

values.name: Broker
values.description: Broker A person or group acting as an agent for others, accepting responsibility in return for a fee.

values.name: Consolidator (master distributor)
values.description: Consolidator (master distributor) A person or group acting as a clearing house for goods or services.

values.name: Dealer
values.description: Dealer A person or group buying directly from a manufacturer for resale.

values.name: Distributor
values.description: Distributor A person or group acting explicitly as distributor of merchandise or goods.

values.name: Jobber
values.description: Jobber A person or group buying merchandise to resell it to a retailer.

values.name: Manufacturer
values.description: Manufacturer A company that produces goods from raw materials.

values.name: OEM (Original equipment manufacturer)
values.description: OEM (Original equipment manufacturer) A manufacturer selling its goods to a company reselling them using own labels.

values.name: Resale
values.description: Resale A class of trade where goods and/or services are purchased for resale.

values.name: Retailer
values.description: Retailer A person selling goods or services in small quantities or by the piece.

values.name: Stationer
values.description: Stationer The trade has a classification of stationer.

values.name: Wholesaler
values.description: Wholesaler A person or group buying goods in large quantities for resale by a retailer.

values.name: User
values.description: User Identifies the end-user of goods or services.

values.name: Out patient
values.description: Out patient A patient not under the full time care of a hospital but visits from time to time for treatment.

values.name: In patient
values.description: In patient A patient under the full time care of a hospital.

values.name: Electricity exchange
values.description: Electricity exchange Identifies the exchange where the intermediaries sell and buy electricity.
